method: The pin was written first, against the CLI contract, with scripts/qc/guard-node-modules-link.mjs absent and no package.json edit. Every case drives the real CLI as a child process with the fixture checkout as its working directory; two cases additionally call the exported decision function through a generated probe module. Nothing is stubbed.

redIsReal: No case passes by accident: every allow case fails on an empty stdout rather than on a wrong reason word, which is what a missing module produces.

No assertion was weakened and no case was skipped. The two cases that would pass without the module (the package.json script pin and the unknown-argument pin) fail on the missing key and the missing binary respectively.
Absolute machine paths in this receipt's expected strings are elided to <tmp> and <worktree> because the fixture directory is minted per run; the raw run printed them in full.
